name: 山海战神
english_name: War God of Mountains and Seas
english_description: A Chinese-language adaptation of Spock's English-language science-fiction engine "Final Frontier v0.6e," part of the simple/ES II engine family. It was the very first library converted for this project, and the template most of the project's later restoration fixes were worked out on. Despite the wuxia-sounding name, it's not a martial-arts MUD but a hard-sci-fi combat simulator, with stats like Strength, Agility, and Technique and mecha- and laser-flavored battles.
